creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A director posted a dismissal to a member and then removed it from the group. The member's wake said "1 new (#13), 1 to you ... Read: muster msg read --group <g>", but `msg read --group <g>` and `msg read --as <pane>` both refused: "<pane> is not in <g>; join it with `muster msg join --group <g>`". Following that hint would rejoin a group the member had just been dismissed from. `muster msg log --group <g>` showed #13.

Measured: 2026-10-01, devenv, a directed council run the way the council skill's "Dismiss a member who is finished" line says.

## Things that might be true

- **Let `msg read` deliver what was addressed to the reader before it was removed**, or point a removed member's wake at `msg log`.
- Drop the join hint when the group's policy removed the reader.
title: A removed member's wake points at msg read, which refuses it
